currentParagraphText: “Ready?” Arnold asked, making Jake refocus as it was finally go-time.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Ready?” Arnold asked, making Jake refocus as it was finally go-time.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Ready as can be,” Jake nodded, and without further ado, the teleporter below him activated.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Only half an hour after Jake finished transmuting his temporary bow, he stood ready on the teleportation platform prepared by Arnold, who was also there to observe and – if necessary – also send Carmen over. Jake considered if he should call others for backup but decided not to. Sylphie was off somewhere on Earth, spending quality time with her parents if Jake’s guess was correct, with everyone else also busy doing their own thing. Not to mention a few weren’t even on the planet in the first place, or the fact that people like Caleb couldn’t get involved due to his faction, and while Casper would have probably loved to go, bringing a Risen along was a surefire way to make them instantly start blasting.
